criteria.label: evidence contract — the integration's attestations honor EVP/1 shape and pins
determinism — identical inputs reproduce identical receipts
replay — the verifier re-derives the evidence byte-for-byte
tamper detection — any byte change flips the verdict fail-closed
security — scoped credentials, revocation, no stored secrets in-repo
compatibility — the integration's surface matches the documented adapter contract

badge.name: CoreGuard Verified Integration
badge.claimTowards: integration passed the CoreGuard Conformance Suite for the pinned version
neverMeans: CoreGuard endorses the counterparty or its project
CoreGuard guarantees the counterparty, its funds, or its adjudication
CoreGuard guarantees any settlement or legal outcome
the integration has any live authority by itself

note: No integration is badge-eligible: CG-CS/1 evidence is collected from real integrations, and none has been run yet. An empty list is the honest state, not a gap to fill with prose.
